intended:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing about flight number AF1522 from Paris to Montreal on the 14th of September, which was cancelled with less than 24 hours' notice. I was offered a rebooking five days later, which was no use to me as I had a conference to attend, so I bought a new ticket with another airline for €860. Under the European regulation, I am entitled to a refund of my original ticket plus compensation. My booking reference is KT7PQ2. I would like the refund of €510 for the original ticket, and the compensation of €600, and also to be reimbursed for the replacement ticket. I look forward to your reply within 14 days.

Yours faithfully,
Claire Dubois

Dear programme committee,

I would like to submit a proposal for a 30-minute talk at the conference in June. The title is How Small Teams Can Cut Cloud Costs Without Slowing Down.

The talk will share what we learned when we reduced our cloud bill by 40% over six months while handling twice the traffic. I will cover three practical areas: rightsizing instances, using spot capacity safely, and building cost alerts into the deployment pipeline. The audience will leave with a checklist they can use the next day.

I have spoken at four conferences before, including the one in Lisbon last year.

Thank you for considering my proposal.

Best regards,
Andrei Popescu
